# Configuration

Settings come from environment variables.

| Variable | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `A2AW_HOME` | `~/.a2a-workbench` | Directory for the SQLite database, the secret key and uploaded files. |
| `A2AW_DATABASE_URL` | — | SQLAlchemy URL of the database; default a SQLite file in the home directory. Postgres: `postgresql+asyncpg://user:password@host/db` (needs the `postgres` extra). Also read from `DATABASE_URL`. |
| `A2AW_HOST` | `127.0.0.1` | Address `serve` binds to. |
| `A2AW_PORT` | `8484` | Port `serve` listens on. |
| `A2AW_MAX_BLOB_BYTES` | `20971520` | Largest file you can upload to attach to a message. |
| `A2AW_ALLOWED_HOSTS` | — | Extra comma-separated host names the server answers to besides localhost and its bind address (DNS-rebinding protection). |
| `A2AW_SECRET_KEY` | — | Key that encrypts stored credentials; default a key generated in `<home>/secret.key`. |
| `A2AW_PUBLIC_BASE_URL` | — | Base URL agents use to reach this server's push webhooks (`/hooks/<id>`). Also read from `PUBLIC_BASE_URL`. |
